A moved entry keeps its grade only on a unique code match, else it is capped at medium (confidence_70707 has the old grade). tc_70755 is the name the TrinityCore fork's 70755 translation puts here when it differs. See docs/PUBLIC_OPCODES_70755.md and EVIDENCE.md E31.
